paper.title: RobotAgentBench: Towards Open-world Robot Autonomy
paper.data: 50 household layouts; 90 atomic, 18 short, 8 long and 4 open-ended scenarios; versioned assets and 1,470 saved configurations.
paper.method: Agent-assisted real-to-sim construction plus planning-execution-verification runtime and task-specific process scoring.
paper.task: Evaluate task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, recovery, robustness and open-ended household autonomy.
paper.novelty: Unifies capability-level and scenario-level open-world robot-agent evaluation under a released physical execution interface.
paper.project_relevance: Direct benchmark/runtime for generated household worlds and autonomous recovery beyond fixed task execution.

paper.title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
paper.data: 30 quantitative experiments in five disciplines on 14 apparatus platforms with resampled hidden parameters.
paper.method: Physics-based laboratory tasks score grounded measurement conclusions and required physical state changes.
paper.task: Evaluate whether an embodied agent can design and execute experiments to discover an initially unknown quantity.
paper.novelty: Bridges manipulation and scientific discovery by requiring physical intervention and instrument reading to know.
paper.project_relevance: Direct closed-loop validator for intervention, observation, state tracking and grounded conclusions in executable worlds.

paper.title: Embodied Playground: A Long-Horizon Agentic Robotics Benchmark for Physical, Strategic, and Spatial Reasoning
paper.data: 410 task environments, EP-100, five suites, 16 task types and difficulty/compact subsets.
paper.method: Shared robot-agent interface with observation/tool budgets and independent goal, rule-compliance and physical-validity checks.
paper.task: Evaluate sustained physical, strategic and spatial reasoning over interdependent long-horizon robot tasks.
paper.novelty: Combines a broad environment catalog with explicit rule and physical-validity evaluation rather than endpoint-only success.
paper.project_relevance: Direct long-horizon evaluation harness for generated interactive scenes, task rules and physical validity.
